name: Presentation-Invariant Supplier Selection Benchmark
description: Reproducibility package for the study “Presentation-Invariant Supplier Selection? Stress-Testing Open-Weight LLM Decision Reliability Under Multi-Objective Conflict,” accepted for presentation at ICLIE 2026. The benchmark evaluates whether open-weight large language models preserve supplier-selection decisions when all decision-relevant information is held constant and only supplier-row order changes. The release contains six independently generated base scenarios, four controlled multi-objective conflict levels, three balanced row-order presentations, and evaluations of three open-weight LLMs, yielding 216 main model calls. The package includes frozen benchmark scenarios, exact prompts, sanitized raw model outputs, scoring and analysis code, identical-input robustness data, design-freeze records, and peer-review revision analyses. The revision-stage statistical analysis treats the six base scenarios as the independent experimental units and reports scenario-cluster uncertainty estimates. No main-study observations or raw outputs were altered during revision. Data and documentation are released under CC BY 4.0; code is released under the MIT License.
